# Lam Pham (Pham Thanh Lam)

> Lam Pham (Phạm Thanh Lâm, also written "Laam") is Chief Data Science & AI Officer at Cake by VPBank, a digital bank in Vietnam named Best Digital Bank in Vietnam 2026 by Euromoney. He leads the DSAI team that builds the models behind credit decisions and revenue forecasting, and runs a fleet of 150+ voice agents that have handled 25M+ real customer calls. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Personal site: https://www.lampt.org

Motto: "Small tools, large systems. AI that handles real money."

## Key facts

- Current role (2024–present): Chief Data Science & AI Officer (CDAO), Cake by VPBank. Cake has ~8M customers, reached EBITDA break-even in Q3 2024 (3.5 years after launch), and grew revenue per customer from $5 (2023) to $25 (2025).
- Current work: moving Cake from digital bank to "Next Gen AI Bank": causal inference for credit risk, multi-agent orchestration, voice-agent fleet management and evaluation (SNR monitoring, golden QA eval sets), and an intel-brief pipeline (PDF → markdown → SQL) that cut the cost of reading a Vietnamese financial report from $8 to $0.80.
- 2019–2023: Co-founder of TrueID and Head of AI Products at VNG Corporation (Vietnam's first tech unicorn). Digital identity and eKYC for financial services; $1M+ ARR AI business, 10M+ users (B2B2C). eKYC liveness confirmed under iBeta ISO 30107-3 PAD; face recognition benchmarked in NIST FRVT 1:1.
- 2015–2018: Lead Data Scientist at Viettel (telco), Sentifi AG (financial sentiment, Switzerland) and VNG (gaming, social).
- 2012–2015: Deputy Head of Mobile at GNT Inc (Mobion Music, #1 on the Japan App Store), FPT Software, co-founder of Saigonapps.
- Education: MSc Computer Science, Saint Petersburg State University, Russia (2001–2008); MSc Business Information Systems, Vietnamese-German University (2010–2012).

## Achievements

- 1st place, WSDM Cup 2019 (ACM WSDM), fake news detection (ByteDance task), 700+ teams, modified BERT: https://github.com/lampts/wsdm19cup
- Kaggle Master (handle: saigonapps). CIKM 2017 (4th), CIKM 2018 (8th), AICovid Vietnam 2021 (2nd).
- Keynote, IFC / World Bank FIDN 2020: "Implementing Digital Identity Platforms for a Digital Economy".
- Speaker: PyCon Singapore 2016 (music2vec, song arithmetic from million playlists), TopDev 2019 (Productionizing AI), VietnamWorks Tech Expo 2016.
- Open source: bert4vn and albert4vn, among the first openly released Vietnamese language models (2019). VietAI open lectures (2017).
- Press: TheLEADER, "Sự trỗi dậy của Cake: Từ Việt Nam đến hình mẫu ngân hàng số khu vực" (Sep 2026): https://theleader.vn/su-troi-day-cua-cake-tu-viet-nam-den-hinh-mau-ngan-hang-so-khu-vuc-d47783.html

## How he builds

- Unix philosophy: small composable tools that multiply force.
- Slope > intercept: hire and build for learning rate and compounding.
- Ship > paper: a model in production beats a model in a notebook.
- Hard to vary: if an element is decorative, remove it.

With inline demos and a closing assessment. (2026-09-20)
